session.starting: The server is waking up, this can take about a minute.
session.unreachable: The server could not be reached. Check your connection and try again.

errors.network: No connection. Try again once you are online.
errors.server: The server is not answering right now. Try again in a moment.

login.title: Sign in
login.wrongBody: Check your details and try again.
login.offlineBody: Turn on Wi-Fi or mobile data and try again.
login.wakingBody: The server sleeps when it has not been used for a while. The first sign-in can take 30–60 seconds; keep the app open.
login.noAccount: No account? Ask your company's administrator.

tasks.title: Tasks
tasks.dataNote: Review and approve them on the web.
tasks.emptyBody: Take a photo below to add a new document from the field.
tasks.errorBody: The server did not answer. Try again a little later.
tasks.viewerNote: You are a viewer; you cannot upload documents.

pick.publishedNote: No documents can be added to a published batch.
pick.stepQuestion: Which step is the document for?

camera.align: Fit the document into the frame
camera.askBody: KozaPass needs your camera to photograph documents. The images are only used in the document you upload.
camera.deniedBody: Allow it in Settings to photograph documents.
camera.deniedStep3: Turn it on and come back

review.title: Review
review.moveHint: To change the order, press and hold a page, then tap the page to swap it with.
review.limitTitle: You reached the limit of {{max}} pages.
review.limitBody: Upload further pages as a separate document.
review.tooLargeBody: Take fewer pages or upload them as a separate document.
review.pickTarget: Tap the page to swap with

upload.readingSub: The fields are being taken from the document. This usually takes 10 s.
upload.waitSub: Starts once the upload is done.
upload.slowBody: You can keep waiting or fill in the fields yourself. The result is added to the form once the reading is done.
upload.failedBody: {{count}} pages are kept on the phone. Try again once you are connected.
upload.published: No documents can be added to a published batch.
upload.limit: A step can hold at most 10 documents.
upload.duplicate: This document is already uploaded for this step.
upload.tooLarge: The pages together are larger than 10 MB.
upload.badPage: Page {{n}} could not be read; take it again.
upload.forbidden: You are not allowed to do this.

form.title: Document
form.manualTitle: The document could not be read, enter the fields by hand.
form.manualBody: The image is blurred or the document type was not recognised.
form.requiredValidUntil: The end of validity is required
form.dateOrder: The end cannot be before the start
form.editorNote: The document is saved. It is used once an owner or admin approves it.
form.viewerNote: You are a viewer; you cannot change the fields.
form.conflictBody: Someone else approved this document. Your changes were not saved.
form.loadError: The document could not be loaded
form.readingNow: The document is still being read; the fields fill in once it is done.
form.saveFailed: The approval could not be saved.

profile.title: Profile
profile.logoutBody: Your e-mail and password are asked at the next sign-in. Pages not uploaded are deleted from the phone.
